استخيروا (form X)
# اُسْتُخِيرُوا (ustuḵīrū) /us.tu.xiː.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخَارَ (istaḵāra)
# اِسْتَخِيرُوا (istaḵīrū) /is.ta.xiː.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخَارَ (istaḵāra)
